visualCharacteristics.purpose: promotion stage: full-bleed background image with a solid dark text card overlaid on the left
traits: dark navy card overlaid left, vertically centred at desktop
card stacks below the image on mobile
small eyebrow line, large heading, arrow CTA link

contentPattern.structure: 1 column. Row 1: background image. Row 2: optional eyebrow paragraph, heading (H1 or H2), optional text, CTA link(s). The first image anywhere is the background; everything else goes into the card, so cell order and count do not matter

usage: Campaign or promotion stage near the top of homepage and hub pages.
reuseGuidance: Use for any image stage with an overlaid text card. For centred text directly on the image use the vanilla hero.
